MiniMines CRM

Comprehensive Master Manual - All Modules

1. Introduction

Welcome to the complete MiniMines CRM. This system manages the end-to-end pipeline covering Lead Generation, Business Development, Quotation Approvals, Operations, and Export Logistics. The platform implements Soft Row-Level Security (RLS) to ensure users only see data relevant to their specific role.

2. Pre-Sales: Enquiries & Leads

2.1 Enquiries Dashboard

Captures initial inbound interest before it is fully qualified as a lead.

2.2 Leads Dashboard (Associate)

The Lead Management Dashboard is where daily prospecting occurs. Associates only see their assigned leads.

3. Sales & BD: Opportunities to Orders

3.1 Opportunity Pipeline

Once a Lead is qualified, it becomes an Opportunity. This initiates active negotiations via the Kanban board (Requirements → Negotiation → Won).

3.2 Quotations & Approvals

Draft proposed rates and submit them for HOD Approval (Draft → Review → Approved/Rejected).

3.3 Sales Orders

Once a quote is approved, a Sales Order is generated for the operations team to fulfill.

4. Post-Sales & Legal

4.1 Contracts Management

Track formal agreements, NDAs, and SLAs associated with Won opportunities.

4.2 Product Database

The central repository for materials and SKUs (e.g., Heavy Truck Swap Packs) that can be quoted.

5. Logistics & Export Compliance

5.1 Export Shipments

Tracks the physical movement of orders (Vessel, Container Numbers, Transit Status: Customs → In Transit → Delivered).

5.2 Export Documents

Ensures mandatory compliance paperwork (EVD, FEMA, SCOMET, HSN, E-Way Bills) is prepared and submitted to the CHA.

6. Global Analytics

The Analytics Dashboard provides real-time SVG charting of performance metrics, conversion funnels, and lead sources across all modules.
